about_the_game:
Alright, alright, let me break it down for you.

Welcome to a new job, a pristine new mall, and a terrifying new reality. You just landed the job of a night shift security guard at an overhyped and pretty garbage mall that's about to open in a week from now. Think it'll be easy?

Nope. It won't.

We've got a guy in a black jacket + blue shirt fit named Nate on his way to your office to kill you, and nobody knows why. All we know is this:

  • Your camera feed is dysfunctional

  • Your closet might not save you

  • and how about that Nate guy? He's all about you being dead.

Why is this Nate guy trying to kill you? No idea.

Why is the mall's security system so cheap? Couldn't tell ya.

Why on EARTH is the game named after THAT midget instead of the mall or something? You have to figure it out yourself.

Here are some tools you can use to survive!

  • 💻 Camera feed that dysfunctions every now and then

  • 🚪 Closet with limited oxygen; Plan carefully!

  • ⭐ Some pretty good looking visuals.. right?

  • 🤡 and your annoying boss who calls you every night just to piss you off.

You've got five nights,

one job,

and ZERO backup.

Welcome to Night Shift at Nate's, the horror game that 100% deserves to be on your wishlist.

Finish the shift, survive the night. Do you think you got what it takes?
